base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687704/attempts/d0cbcca9117b44429be50328a5ec3220/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
        objects.append((c0, color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    r0 = c0 = 0
    first_color = objects[0][1] if objects else None
    for i, (_, color, oh, ow, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        if i:
            ph, pw = objects[i-1][2], objects[i-1][3]
            r0 += ph-1
            c0 += pw-1
        for dr, dc in shape:
            r, c = r0+dr, c0+dc
            if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                # The first object remains visible at its shared corner when it is color 1.
                if not (first_color == 1 and out[r][c] == first_color):
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
